# QTI Results Test Cases

This folder contains CSV inputs and expected QTI Results Reporting outputs
for representative cases.

- Descriptive (free-response)
  - Input: `descriptive.csv`
  - Output: `descriptive.qti.xml`
- Choice
  - Input: `choice.csv`
  - Output: `choice.qti.xml`
- Fill-in-the-blank
  - Input: `cloze.csv`
  - Output: `cloze.qti.xml`
- Source-driven cloze response structure
  - Items: `items/item-cloze-distinct.qti.xml`, `items/item-cloze-ordered.qti.xml`, `items/item-cloze-single.qti.xml`
